name: smtp-egress
description: Send plain-text email over authenticated SMTP (STARTTLS) through a local SOCKS5 proxy, so the sending machine's own IP never reaches the Received: headers — an egress check that refuses unless the proxied exit differs from the direct v4 /24 and v6 /48, a send script that runs it first and logs every send without the body, a header check that proves the result on a delivered probe, a doctor, and a PreToolUse guard that asks a human before every send and before any raw SMTP bypass.
